# Theme 02 — Orbital Cascade Arcade

**Working titles:** Orbital Cascade · Cascade Shells · Seam Collapse

**Role:** High-dopamine companion mode / mobile demake / trailer juice.

Already sketched in [`../../cascade.html`](../../cascade.html).

---

## Fantasy

Nested shell towers fall into a field. Dock towers that share a deep core.
The core contracts, a scalar spark scores, one residual tower remains and can
chain again.

Closer to **Puyo Puyo / Candy Crush chain feel** than to factory planning.

---

## Visual language

| Algebra | Look |
|---------|------|
| Tower | Stacked shells (cocoon nesting) |
| Shared core | Amber lock on deepest rung |
| Collapse | Inward zip from deep shell outward |
| Scalar | Floating score burst + chain multiplier |
| Residual | Wider tower falls into place |
| Zero | Blue dashed “= 0” partners annihilate |

---

## Strengths

- Fast to understand; high session density.
- Perfect for marketing GIFs and tutorial “feel” of a merge.
- Nested depth finally *feels* like depth when collapse is staggered.

## Weaknesses

- Less unique commercially than a full factory.
- Easy to look like “match-3 with science paint.”
- Current arcade page *removes* contracted symbols for balance — not engine-exact.
  Keep the chamber as the exact reading.

---

## Commercial use

- Steam demo opener / prologue missions.
- Mobile spin-off.
- In-foundry “reaction camera” when a reactor fires.

---

## Decision notes

Choose as **juice layer**, not as the only product, unless the goal is a smaller
arcade title rather than a Zachtronics-scale factory game.
